text: Claude Code: add a local stdio MCP server with claude mcp add. It saves it in ~/.claude.json, scoped to this project.
claude mcp list starts the server and checks it. Status: Connected.
Codex: the same server with codex mcp add.
codex mcp list shows it as enabled. Auth is unsupported for a local stdio server.
Codex keeps it in ~/.codex/config.toml, in an [mcp_servers.docs] table.
